Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease
Required findings: Plain radiographs and advanced imaging (CT or MRI) demonstrate moderate to severe single‑level disc degeneration at the requested level(s)
Chronic, unremitting discogenic axial low‑back pain with associated disability secondary to single‑level degenerative disc disease for ≥1 year
Significant daily pain causing functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing)
Structured physician‑supervised, multi‑modal non‑operative management that includes regularly scheduled appointments and documented follow‑up evaluations

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following for ≥12 consecutive months (unless contraindicated): prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/steroids/gabapentinoids, provider‑directed exercise program, epidural steroid injection or selective nerve‑root block at the same level, facet joint injection/medial branch block/radiofrequency ablation
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, opioid or alcohol use disorder)
Nicotine‑free status documented by either never‑smoker status or abstinence ≥6 weeks verified by objective cotinine testing (serum, urine, or saliva)
Medical necessity indications.Source: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease

Non-Indications: Multilevel disc degeneration or pathology beyond a single level
Imaging does not show moderate‑to‑severe degeneration at a single level
Failure to complete ≥12 months of at least two specified conservative therapies
Absence of structured physician‑supervised non‑operative management with regular visits and follow‑up
Presence of unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Current smoker or nicotine use without documented 6‑week abstinence and cotinine verification
Contraindication to required conservative modalities without documented alternative justification
Important criteria & exceptions: All listed conservative therapy criteria must be met; if a patient cannot tolerate a specific modality, another qualifying modality must still satisfy the “≥2 modalities for ≥12 months” rule
Nicotine‑free verification must be objective (cotinine test) unless patient is a documented never‑smoker
Mental health disorders must be managed; unmanaged conditions exclude coverage
Conservative management must be physician‑directed and documented; informal or unsupervised therapy does not satisfy the requirement
Documentation required: Plain radiograph report (AP/lateral) of lumbar spine
CT or MRI report demonstrating moderate to severe single‑level disc degeneration
Clinical note confirming chronic discogenic axial low‑back pain ≥1 year with functional impairment
Physical therapy or other licensed provider notes showing regularly scheduled appointments and follow‑up evaluations
Medication history showing prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/steroids/gabapentinoids use for ≥12 months

Records of at least two of the following performed at the same level(s): epidural steroid injection/ selective nerve‑root block, facet joint injection/ medial branch block/ radiofrequency ablation, documented exercise program duration ≥12 months
Mental health assessment confirming absence of unmanaged significant disorder
Smoking cessation documentation: never‑smoker statement or nicotine abstinence ≥6 weeks with cotinine test result (lab report)
